services.title: How can I help?
services.subtitle: No coding knowledge needed — tell me your business goal and I'll suggest a solution that fits your budget.

items.title: Business websites & landing pages
items.description: Customers find you on Google, browse your products and message you in one tap. Looks great on every phone.

items.title: Online stores & booking
items.description: Product catalog, cart, appointment booking, orders straight from your own site — no marketplace fees.

items.title: Management software
items.description: Orders, customers, inventory, staff and revenue reports in one place — instead of scattered notebooks and spreadsheets.

items.title: Automation & AI
items.description: Automatic Excel processing, scheduled reports, chatbots for customer questions — hours of manual work saved every week.

items.title: Fixes & upgrades
items.description: Slow site, broken mobile layout, missing features? I'll review it and quote a quick fix.

items.title: Domain, hosting & SEO
items.description: Domain (.vn/.com), hosting, Google Maps and Google Analytics set up so your site runs reliably.

items.title: Hán Ngữ Studio
items.problem: Vietnamese learners of Chinese lacked a free, easy tool for handwriting practice.
items.solution: A web app that generates printable A4 handwriting sheets and segments Chinese text automatically.
items.result: Runs entirely in the browser, nothing to install, free for everyone.

items.title: Teacher landing page
items.problem: Private tutors send long chat messages to parents, which doesn't build trust.
items.solution: One-page site with classes, free slots, reviews and a Zalo button; 8 selectable themes, light and dark.
items.result: All copy lives in one JSON file, so a new client means a new file. Every change gets an automatic preview.

items.title: Speak Log
items.problem: Practising English speaking alone, you never know what you got wrong.
items.solution: A 2-minute daily recording app: speech-to-text, AI feedback (one fix, one strength), and model pronunciation playback.
items.result: Installs like a phone app (PWA); AI cost is about one cent per session.

items.title: Personal sites for students
items.problem: Students applying for tutoring jobs or internships need a tidy link instead of a paper CV.
items.solution: A sales page for 500,000–1,000,000 VND packages with two sample pages (tutor, intern), delivered in days.
items.result: Reusable templates: each new site only needs new content.

items.title: Language Learning Platform
items.problem: Needed a language-learning platform with learning paths, exercises and progress tracking.
items.solution: Courses, lessons, vocabulary and auto-graded quizzes, Duolingo-style.
items.result: Learners see their progress clearly; new courses and content are easy to add.

process.title: A clear, transparent way of working

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.description: Tell me what you need over Zalo or a call; I'll suggest the right solution.

steps.title: Quote & timeline
steps.description: A detailed written quote with agreed scope and delivery date before any work starts.

steps.title: Build & demo
steps.description: You see regular demos and can give feedback while the work is in progress.

steps.title: Hand-over & support
steps.description: Full hand-over, a walkthrough on how to use it, and bug-fix support once it's live.

ctaRepeat.note: No tech knowledge needed. Even if we don't work together, you'll leave knowing what kind of site fits and roughly what it costs.

items.q: How long does a website take?
items.a: A landing page usually takes 5–7 days, a business website 1–2 weeks, management software 3–6 weeks. The exact timeline is written in the quote.
Within 3 days of receiving the deposit. If my schedule is full, I'll give you a specific start date before you pay the deposit.
A 50% deposit when you accept the quote, and the other 50% at hand-over, once you've reviewed it and are happy. Payment is by bank transfer, as set out in the quote.

items.q: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
items.a: Not at all. Just describe your business; I take care of the technical side and show you how to update content yourself.

items.q: Can you help with domain and hosting?
items.a: Yes. Student personal pages run on free hosting at no extra cost; if you want your own domain, you only pay for the domain. For landing pages and websites, I'll recommend and register a domain (.vn, .com) and suitable hosting; you pay those fees directly to the provider.

items.q: What if something needs fixing after hand-over?
items.a: Bugs on my side are fixed free for 30 days after hand-over; just tell me on Zalo. After that, content changes are 50,000 VND each; new features are quoted separately.
Yes. You own all the source code, the domain and the data.

items.q: Roughly how much does a website cost?
items.a: Personal page for a student (tutoring, internship applications): 500,000 / 800,000 / 1,000,000 VND. Landing page for a shop, café or online seller: from 1,500,000 VND. Small automation tool (Google Sheet, order-alert bot): from 1,000,000 VND. Multi-page website or management software: quoted after hearing your needs. Advice and quotes are free.

items.q: You have a full-time job. Can you keep to the schedule?
items.a: By day I'm a Python developer at Akselos; I do outside projects in the evenings and at weekends. So I only take a few projects at a time and put the delivery date in the quote.

items.q: Do you build custom features, or only use templates?
items.a: Both. Templates are faster and cheaper; if you need something specific like bookings, order management or a Google Sheet connection, I build it to order.

items.q: Do I have to sign a long-term contract?
items.a: No. Each job has its own quote. Monthly maintenance only if you want it.

items.q: I'm in another city. Can we still work together?
items.a: Yes. Everything happens over Zalo, with a video call when needed. I'm based in Ho Chi Minh City but work with clients anywhere.
